howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: A straightforward and fully transparent 4-step process.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Send us your property location and basic details via form or message.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We define the schedule, sign a written contract, and secure keys in a safe.
howItWorks.step3Desc: We visit the property, record a video, inspect the installations and condition of the facility.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Receive a comprehensive report with timestamped photos directly via WhatsApp or portal.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions from property owners.
faq.q1: What happens if you spot a breakdown, water leak or damage?
faq.a1: We will contact you immediately and send photo/video proof. For observed faults, we suggest the following steps and, with your consent, we coordinate a repairman. Domovik does not provide security services or guarantee burglary prevention.
faq.q2: How are my property keys stored?
faq.a2: Keys are signed for upon handover and secured inside a coded, fire-rated safe. Every key check-out is logged with exact time and signature.
faq.q3: How can I be certain that you actually visited?
faq.a3: Every visit includes timestamped photo documentation and raw video footage embedding exact GPS location and time metadata.
faq.q4: Can I book a single one-off visit?
faq.a4: Yes! We offer on-demand one-off inspections — for instance, following severe storms, hail, or when you need emergency parcel reception.
faq.a5: Yes — watering the plants, mowing the grass, trimming the trees, cleaning and preparing the home for arrival. Additional services are agreed upon and charged separately.
faq.a6: We provide regular tours, condition checks and reports in accordance with the contract. We are not a security agency and do not guarantee the security of the facility.

servicesPage.title: Services & Care Plans
servicesPage.subtitle: Regular inspections, condition checks, reports and additional maintenance services.
servicesPage.introText: An empty house can quickly accumulate moisture, dust and unnoticed problems. With regular visits, we detect leaks, damages and changes in the building. Domovik is your local support while you are not present.

visitChecklist.title: 15-Step Visit Protocol & Checklist
visitChecklist.subtitle: Every visit follows an exacting, standardized 15-step inspection checklist.
visitChecklist.notice: All videos and photos are archived on a private server and are available to the owner at any time.

steps.title: 1. Arrival & GPS check-in
steps.desc: Digital logging of the exact arrival time and location via app.

steps.title: 2. Start of video recording
steps.desc: Activation of high-definition camera upon approach to the gate and house.

steps.title: 3. Perimeter inspection
steps.desc: Inspection of exterior fences, gates, drainpipes, and walkways.

steps.title: 4. Front doors & locks verification
steps.desc: Physical check of the correctness of locks and door frames.

steps.title: 5. Windows & shutters check
steps.desc: Overview of windows, closing mechanisms and blinds.

steps.title: 6. Plumbing & water check
steps.desc: Reading water meter, testing taps, checking for leaks, damp spots or water odors.

steps.title: 7. Electrical system check
steps.desc: Inspecting breaker panel, meter reading, fridge/freezer operation check.

steps.title: 8. Mailbox collection
steps.desc: Emptying mailbox, photographing critical mail/bills, alerting the owner.

steps.title: 9. Yard & grounds inspection
steps.desc: Checking for fallen branches, lawn conditions, proper rain runoff.

steps.title: 10. Interior room walkthrough
steps.desc: Inspecting ceilings (water leaks), walls, floors, and general ventilation.

steps.title: Checking sensors and devices
steps.desc: Checking smoke detectors and batteries on installed devices.

steps.title: 12. Key zone photo documentation
steps.desc: Capturing timestamped photos of all predefined inspection zones.

steps.title: 13. End of video recording
steps.desc: Closing the facility and gate and final condition check.

steps.title: 14. Digital report delivery
steps.desc: Full inspection report with photos sent directly to WhatsApp or portal.

steps.title: 15. Anomaly response
steps.desc: Immediate call to the owner and pre-approved action if anything is amiss.

contractPage.title: Contract & Legal Responsibility
contractPage.subtitle: We respect your property and work strictly on the foundation of a formal written contract.
contractPage.intro: Entrusting keys to your home requires total trust. That is why our working relationship is legally formalized in every aspect.

pillars.title: What We Do
pillars.desc: Regular tours, condition checks, ventilation, video/photo reporting and coordination of additional services.

pillars.title: What We DO NOT Do
pillars.desc: We are not a security agency and we do not provide physical security services. We do not guarantee the security of the facility; we provide regular checks, documentation and timely notification of owners.

pillars.title: Dealing with keys
pillars.desc: If necessary, the keys are picked up by agreement and recorded. Details are regulated by contract.

pillars.title: Data & Privacy Protection
pillars.desc: Inspection footage is stored on encrypted storage and is never made public or transferred to third parties.

emergencySteps: 1. Immediate photo/video documentation without disturbing evidence.
2. Urgent phone call to the property owner.
Ako vlasnik nije dostupan: postupanje po unapred dogovorenom planu i obaveštenje nadležnih službi ako je potrebno.
4. In case of water rupture: closing main valve and dispatching emergency plumbing team.
Pisani izveštaj o događaju i preduzetim koracima.

about.title: About Domovik Caretaking
about.subtitle: Your dedicated, reliable, and local property caretaker in Serbia.
about.storyText: It all started from direct personal need: relatives and friends living in Vienna, Munich, and Zurich were constantly worried about their family homes back in Serbia. Did a recent hailstorm break roof tiles? Did the freezer shut down? Has unpaid mail piled up? Asking neighbors often felt burdensome and lacked accountability. Domovik was created to provide institutional reliability and peace of mind.
about.v1Desc: We treat your property with the utmost care, confidentiality, and discretion.
about.v2Desc: Inspection schedules are upheld consistently, regardless of weather conditions.
about.v3Desc: Every visit and issue is documented with video and raw geotagged photos.
about.v4Desc: We are easily reachable via modern messaging channels like WhatsApp and Viber.
